label: Bible Study
prompt: And the LORD shall make thee the head, and not the _____; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the LORD thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do them:
verse: And the LORD shall make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the LORD thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do them:
note: Part of Moses' blessings for obedience — leading the parade, not trailing behind it.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Israel, and they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit them; and they shall plant _____, and drink the wine thereof; they shall also make gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
verse: And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Israel, and they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine thereof; they shall also make gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
note: Exiles back home, rebuilding cities and planting vineyards — and this time, they get to drink the wine.

label: Sunday School
prompt: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a _____ gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!
verse: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!
note: Jesus pictures himself as a mother hen gathering her chicks — tender words for a city that kept refusing.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And Jabez was more _____ than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.
verse: And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.
note: Jabez was named for his mother's painful birth, yet he stands out in a long list of names as the one who prayed.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And there were four _____ men at the entering in of the gate: and they said one to another, Why sit we here until we die?
verse: And there were four leprous men at the entering in of the gate: and they said one to another, Why sit we here until we die?
note: Four 'leprous' men at Samaria's gate asked the question that saved a starving city: 'Why sit we here until we die?'
